lines: Persistent morning headaches, fatigue, and shortness of breath with exertion.

He describes the headaches as dull, bilateral, and more prominent in the early morning.
He also notes that climbing stairs leaves him more winded than usual, though he has no chest pain, palpitations, or recent illness.
